label: Demand-and-supply market equilibrium model
purpose: Explain and predict how price and quantity are determined in a market for a good or service.

assumptions.text: A single market for a good or service; other variables affecting demand/supply are held constant (ceteris paribus as stated for the laws of demand and supply).
Price is on the vertical axis and quantity on the horizontal axis; demand and supply curves can be plotted together.
Buyers and sellers respond to price incentives; markets tend toward equilibrium.

scope.text: Introductory economics; markets for goods and services

limitations: Not spelled out in the captured blocks. The source presents a standard partial-equilibrium demand/supply model; shifts, elasticity, efficiency, and market-structure caveats are outside this pilot.
notes: True Model candidate: has components, assumptions, scope, predictions, and an implicit representational structure. This is not a mere convention/frame.
